builtins.coreDatabaseDescription: Opens the application database and upgrades its schema at startup. Almost every feature depends on it.
builtins.coreRegistriesDescription: Collects scheduled tasks and background job types from each module so the scheduler and job executor know what work is available.
builtins.kernelDurableEventsDescription: Stores system events, such as media deletion, before delivering them to subscribing plugins. Delivery resumes when a disabled plugin returns.
builtins.kernelPluginEventsDescription: Lets plugins register and publish events for other plugins and webhooks. Declared notifications reach phones and IM only after your approval.
builtins.kernelHostOpsDescription: Lets plugins call application features, such as searching for media or creating subscriptions, within the permissions you approved.
builtins.kernelPluginDataDescription: Provides separate storage for each plugin. Plugins can access only their own data, and sensitive values can be encrypted.
builtins.kernelPluginJobsDescription: Lets plugins hand off slow work to background jobs. The job center manages queues, progress, resumable execution and cancellation.
builtins.kernelPluginHealthDescription: Lets plugins report problems such as expired tokens or unavailable services. Creates system notices for problems and clears them after recovery.
builtins.kernelPluginRoutesDescription: Lets plugins expose web APIs and generate signed links that work without signing in, such as playback links in .strm files.
builtins.kernelPluginCallbacksDescription: Provides URLs for external platforms, such as chat services, to call plugins. Each URL has its own secret and can be revoked separately.
builtins.kernelPluginFilesDescription: Lets plugins read and write within approved folders, such as libraries and import folders. Access outside those folders is denied.
builtins.coreSecretsDescription: Prepares encryption keys so sensitive information, such as site credentials, is encrypted before being saved to the database.
builtins.coreSettingsDescription: Saves and reads application settings, including the configuration shown on settings pages.
builtins.kernelNoticesDescription: Creates pending notices and alerts administrators when a plugin fails to start. Clears them after recovery and also reports entry into safe mode.
builtins.coreEgressDescription: Selects a direct connection or proxy for outgoing requests according to Network and proxy settings.
builtins.coreScrapeRuntimeDescription: Loads metadata preferences at startup, including language priorities, artwork choices and theatrical region, for metadata retrieval and discovery.
builtins.playbackRemoteConfigDescription: Loads remote transcoding settings at startup so playback can decide whether to use a remote machine.
builtins.coreHttpClientsDescription: Manages network connections shared by discovery and the image proxy, and releases them when the application closes.
builtins.trackerSitesDescription: Loads the PT site catalog, including bundled, plugin-provided and custom configurations, to determine which sites are supported.
builtins.trackerSiteAccessDescription: Maintains PT site sessions for reuse by torrent synchronization, searches and downloads, avoiding a new sign-in for every operation.
builtins.selfhealCredentialsDescription: Resets site and AI model configurations left in verification after a previous shutdown, and encrypts legacy plaintext site credentials.
builtins.libraryBuiltinCollectionsDescription: Adds the built-in My favorites collection to each library at startup if it is missing.
builtins.agentRunsDescription: Manages ongoing AI assistant conversations, including background execution and viewing progress after reconnecting.
builtins.agentSessionIndexDescription: Reconciles the AI assistant session list with conversation files at startup, including after an unexpected shutdown.
builtins.agentAttachmentsDescription: Removes AI assistant image attachments that were uploaded more than 24 hours ago and never sent.
builtins.agentInvokeTitle: Plugin access to the AI assistant
builtins.agentInvokeDescription: Lets plugins invoke the AI assistant within approved permissions, either waiting for a result or consuming a stream of events, for example in protocol adapters.
builtins.enrichBackfillDescription: Reidentifies cached site torrents in the background at startup after torrent recognition rules change.
builtins.libraryDiscImageDurationsDescription: Corrects inaccurate ISO disc image durations in the background after startup, preventing incorrect progress or immediate completion when playback starts.
builtins.libraryDolbyVisionBackfillDescription: Adds missing format information to previously imported Dolby Vision files in the background so playback can choose direct play or transcoding correctly.
builtins.appUpdateDescription: Checks for new versions daily and removes expired records left by previous updates at startup.
builtins.downloadsDescription: Synchronizes new site torrents, matches subscriptions, tracks downloads and replaces dead torrents. Media deletion can also remove download tasks and source files.
builtins.boostDescription: Downloads and seeds freeleech torrents as soon as they appear, replacing them automatically within the configured budget.
builtins.subscriptionDescription: Searches for missing subscription content, chooses downloads when waiting periods end, and cleans up related download tasks and files when subscriptions are canceled.
builtins.trackerSearchRunsDescription: Runs site resource searches in the background. Progress remains available after leaving or refreshing the search page.
builtins.libraryCoreDescription: Runs library scans, organization and renaming, item transfers, trash cleanup, chapter thumbnails, intro detection, duplicate detection and clip preparation.
builtins.mediaScrapeDescription: Refreshes metadata for individual items or whole libraries, retrieving descriptions, cast, crew and artwork from TMDB.
builtins.subtitleGenDescription: Selects source subtitles, translates them with an AI model, checks their quality and generates new subtitle files.
builtins.schedulerDescription: Runs each module’s scheduled tasks at the configured times and automatically removes expired execution records and caches.
builtins.boostSentinelDescription: Monitors upload bandwidth during ratio boosting and limits downloads when necessary to protect upload capacity.
builtins.libraryWatchDescription: Watches library folders and records new files automatically, keeping deletions and renames synchronized as well.
builtins.libraryIngestWatchDescription: Watches download folders, identifies completed content and hard links or copies it into a library or specified folder.
builtins.channelsHubDescription: Connects configured chat channels, such as Telegram, Feishu and WeChat, and passes incoming messages to the AI assistant for replies.
builtins.cloudDescription: Connects to MovieClaw Cloud for services such as mobile push. Sends no cloud requests when disconnected.
builtins.pushHubDescription: Converts system events, such as newly imported media, into notifications according to notification rules and delivers them to phones and IM.
builtins.webhookDeliveryDescription: Delivers selected system events to URLs configured under Settings → Webhook. Failed deliveries are retried and retained across restarts.
builtins.pushChannelsRefreshDescription: Checks for outdated push channel information every half hour and refreshes it so mobile notifications use the appropriate channel.
builtins.pushArrivalsDescription: Checks every two minutes for newly imported library content and sends mobile notifications.
builtins.jellyfinDiscoveryDescription: Answers automatic discovery requests from MovieClaw apps and Jellyfin clients on the local network so they can find this server without a manually entered address.
builtins.jobsDescription: Executes queued background jobs, such as import, metadata and subtitle generation, saving progress to the database so work can resume after a restart.
builtins.librarySearchIndexDescription: Maintains the library’s name search index, including pinyin, updating it in the background when titles are added or renamed.
builtins.libraryMediaServerRefreshDescription: Notifies Emby or Jellyfin when library contents change, including additions, deletions, trash changes and transfers. Nearby changes are combined into one refresh.
builtins.storageGuardDescription: Checks for unregistered folders under the data folder at startup and logs warnings without changing them.
builtins.subtitlePgsWarmDescription: Checks image subtitle recognition tools in the background after startup for use by AI subtitle preflight checks.
builtins.librarySkipSegmentsDescription: Checks after startup for libraries whose intro and credits detection needs recalculation, such as after an algorithm update, and queues background jobs.
builtins.playbackRemoteWorkersDescription: Registers and manages connected remote transcoding machines so web playback can use them.
builtins.drivesSourcesDescription: Provides byte access to cloud-only library files, using direct cloud links for transcoding, subtitles and keyframes.
builtins.drivesUploadsDescription: Uploads and verifies newly imported local files for libraries with a cloud primary root, releases local copies after verification, synchronizes cloud changes and completes missing media specifications.
builtins.playbackTranscodeDescription: Manages web playback transcoding sessions, starting transcoding on demand and cleaning up idle sessions and files left by previous runs.
builtins.appUpdateStartupCheckDescription: Checks for a new version a few minutes after startup in Docker deployments.
